name: buja-auto-spa-erp
description: Offline-first ERP for Buja Auto Spa - Truck parts, maintenance, EV & truck rentals, car wash

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test:build: npm run build && echo 'Build successful - foundation verified'
